entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. How can I help you today?
Hi, I'm calling about an order I recently received. The bike I ordered arrived damaged.
I'm so sorry to hear that you received a damaged bike. Could you please provide me with your order number so I can look into this for you?
Thank you. Okay, I see your order here. Can you describe the damage for me?

Well, the bike box looked like it went through a warzone. When I opened it, the first thing I noticed was a pretty significant cracked frame. Then, when I tried to assemble it, I found that one of the wheels is incredibly wobbly. It's definitely not safe to ride.

Oh dear, that sounds terrible! A cracked frame and wobbly wheel are definitely not acceptable. It sounds like there was some serious shipping damage during transit. I sincerely apologize for this inconvenience. To resolve this for you immediately, I'd like to offer you a full refund for the bike. Would that be acceptable?
Yes, a full refund would be great.

Excellent. I've already processed the refund, and you should see it reflected in your account within 5-7 business days. Also, we don't want you to have to worry about returning the damaged bike. We'll email you a free label so you can easily ship it back to us at your convenience. You won't have to pay anything for the return.
Wow, that's fantastic! So I get a full refund and a free label to return the bike? That's really great customer service.
Yes, that's correct. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, I think that's all. Thank you so much for your help!
You're very welcome! We appreciate your business, and again, we apologize for the damaged bike. Have a great day!
